_readme: The warden's default line, named by the NPC in the map. The game's hooks return false
when they have nothing better to say, and this is what runs then - which is the whole
shape of the seam: a game takes the cases it cares about and leaves the rest to data.
Rewritten for M13. She used to bar the gate for no stated reason; now she says what she
barred it against, and what has moved into the hollow since - so both fights the quest
requires are announced before the player walks into either.

greet.speaker: Warden
greet.text: The gate is barred, and I am the one who barred it. Something took the keep, and I could not take it back.

why.speaker: Warden
why.text: The key went into the hollow, west of here, some years ago. What nests on it now is why nobody has fetched it.

good.speaker: Warden
good.text: Then you are already doing more than I have in a decade. Mind the smith on your way - she keeps something for cuts.

fair.speaker: Warden
fair.text: It is. And it will still be my problem tomorrow.
